# chameleon_catalog_role (Resource)

Manages a Polaris catalog role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chameleon_warehouse" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}

resource "chameleon_catalog_role" "reader" {
  catalog = chameleon_warehouse.analytics.name
  name    = "analytics_reader"
  properties = {
    description = "Reader role scoped to the analytics catalog"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog (warehouse) the role belongs to.
- `name` (String) Catalog role name.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Free-form metadata attached to the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `<catalog>/<name>`.
